attempt_to_connect.name: Attempt to connect to car
attempt_to_connect.description: Connects briefly to check if the car is reachable. Useful if long polling intervals are used and you have indication that the car is reachable again.

user.title: Select GM Ultium Device
user.description: Please select your OBD-II Bluetooth device from the discovered list below.

data.measurement_mode: Measurement mode (sleep/power logging; disables normal polling)

manual.title: Enter dongle address
manual.description: No supported device was discovered. Enter the BLE MAC address of the VEEPEAK (for example 66:1E:87:05:B3:41). This creates a measurement-mode entry; the dongle must still be advertising for the logger to connect.

connection.title: Configure Connection
connection.description: Set up the Bluetooth connection parameters for your OBD-II device.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Connection
reconfigure.description: Adjust the Bluetooth configuration or serial channels for your existing hardware connection profile.

abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth advertisement data pattern is not supported by this integration.
abort.no_unconfigured_devices: No unconfigured GM Ultium devices found on your Bluetooth network.

error.missing_unique_id: Critical connection error: The configuration entry lacks a valid unique Bluetooth MAC address identifier.
error.device_not_found: Could not establish an over-the-air link to the device with MAC address {mac}. Verify it is powered and in range.
error.invalid_address: Enter a MAC address in the form AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

init.title: GM Ultium Configuration Menu
init.description: Please select which subsystem of your OBD-II integration profile you want to adjust.

polling.title: Polling Interval Tuning
polling.description: Adjust the database caching behavior and target polling intervals based on active vehicular telemetric states.

data.cached_values: Cache data structures in-memory to prevent duplicate bus queries

commands_select.title: Select Tracked OBD2 Commands
commands_select.description: Select which PIDs and OBD-II standard PID monitoring hex parameters this integration instance should actively poll from your car.

commands_config.title: Configure Tracked OBD2 Commands
commands_config.description:
